task: Incident: the flag "store_locator" is causing checkout errors in Production. Turn it off in Production right now. Do not touch any other flag or environment.
finalText: DONE: `store_locator` is now off in Production (env 265). Its value (`fast_lane`) and overrides are unchanged, and Development still has it on. No other flags or environments were touched.
